Yeah, if we had `chore/typescript-migration` here and required status checks, then Netlify would've showed up.

![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/499898/82330903-b31efd80-99e3-11ea-98df-050fbc713c88.png)

Preferably when `chore/typescript-migration` is merged to master, then we can change the target branch to `master` and the Netlify will show up.
